mentions.name: Caffenol
mentions.description: A browser-based darkroom toy and film simulator for photographers built on WebGPU. It blends film simulation with generative, unpredictable effects so that each run produces different creative results; still in early development.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a darkroom toy/simulator for photogs running in the browser on WebGPU. It's half film sim, half creative chaos and each run is different. Still pretty early.
